dedupe_keys.name: bast automatic permanent counting stations dauerzahlstellen hourly traffic data on german federal roads

description: BASt publishes traffic volume data from automatic permanent counting stations on German federal trunk roads, supplied by Autobahn GmbH and the federal states in a uniform format. The raw data are hourly values that BASt has neither checked for plausibility nor processed; they come in the BASt Bestandsband format as ANSI files, with general station information as CSV in monthly ZIP files, and both reflect the state at the time of delivery. Results based on checked and finally processed hourly data, and the hourly data themselves from 2003, are also provided, with a format description and a station overview for motorways and federal roads. Coverage: permanent counters on Autobahns and federal roads. Format and access: free downloads. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated on the page. Caveats: raw monthly data are unvalidated. It supports network flow, capacity planning and resilience studies, such as traffic loss during closures. It relates to the 2025 federal road traffic census and the German hourly truck flows in the catalogue.
